_comment: control-server#518, #548: the Map 26 preset for the v2 parallel instance, selected with TaskTypeStations:settingsFile. It is loaded only into a database with no binding set for Map 26 yet; an existing instance changes its bindings through FieldOps activate-task-type-stations with scripts/parallel/task-type-stations.map-26.candidate.json, which carries these six bindings plus WIRE_TO_FULL_INSPECTION at station 229 (control-server#777; TaskTypeStationStartupTests pins the candidate as this preset plus that one binding). Stations and names as the user filled them in on 2026-10-10 (control-server#547), checked read-only against RIoT on 2026-10-11: evidence/field/20261011-B10-05-map26-task-type-stations/catalog-26.json. Every siteVerificationRef is the site-use verification the user made in person on 2026-10-10 (REQ-0338). 220 and 221 are two docking positions of the same nitrogen cabinet, one station each. WIRE_TO_FULL_INSPECTION (control-server#737) has its rule and deliberately neither a binding nor a place in requiredTaskTypes: its station is not on Map 26 yet, a required task type without a binding refuses the whole start, and an unrequired one is refused alone as TASK_TYPE_BINDING_MISSING. Its station 229 「全检」 was built on 2026-10-19 (control-server#738) and is bound only in the candidate: this preset was left at six because its catalog evidence predates 229, so a new database starts with six and the full-inspection binding is activated again (control-server#777).
